Sedona Wednesday Evening Mountain Bike Ride

Sedona, AZ · West Sedona · Mountain bike

No-drop

Sedona Wednesday Evening Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Sedona, AZ. Schedule: Every Wednesday evening; time and meetup posted in the Facebook group each Monday, from West Sedona (exact meetup posted in the Facebook group each Monday). About 10–15 miles, no-drop, intermediate, 1.5–2 hours, finishes after dark (lights required).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop, intermediate, 1.5–2 hours, finishes after dark (lights required). It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sedona Wednesday Evening Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A weekly intermediate trail ride in West Sedona, coordinated through a Facebook group of about 600 locals and visitors. No-drop. Meeting spot and time are posted each week in the group.
